log: Working out who would actually buy this
Discovering candidates and exact source URLs (stage 1 of 2)
Fetching up to 10 exact URLs; validating against at most 48,000 characters
Evaluating candidates against 1 fetched pages (stage 2 of 2)

Coverage is strongest in French-language Reddit communities and CABAIA-hosted product reviews. Vendor-hosted reviews demonstrate reported usage and complaints but are not independent evidence of product performance. Searches did not produce reliable population counts, organizational procurement examples, warranty approval rates, current stock reliability, boutique/web price parity, clinical-bag compliance, seam-level waterproof testing or independent load tests. The supplied capability catalogue also omits the laptop, organization, parenting and cycling specifications needed to qualify several candidates; those remain unknown rather than unsupported. The marketingos-brand-audit skill's evidence-discipline guidance was used, but its full application-audit workflow was outside this discovery-only request.
